hypothesis: First and last appearances of marine taxa are near-synchronous across distant regions.
pass_criterion: For marine genera with occurrences in at least 2 distant ocean basins, the first-appearance stage agrees in at least 85% of cases and the median offset is 0 stages.
fail_criterion: Agreement below 60%, or median regional offset of 1 stage or more.
interpretation: 'Almost simultaneously' means within one geological stage in a broad sense.

dataset.name: The Paleobiology Database
dataset.why_it_fits: Marine occurrences with paleocoordinates and ages allow comparing first appearances across regions.
